description: Pulse Wave 6.1.14 — In-App Updater Overhaul, Fast Redirect-Safe Downloads, FileProvider Fix, Interactive Vinyl Turntable & Scratching, Size-Oriented Turntable Widget & Library Reordering.

changelog.title: In-App Updater Overhaul & Installation Fix
items: OkHttp Multi-Hop Redirect Engine: Swapped out legacy connection with OkHttp supporting 302 GitHub redirect asset streams and proper user-agent headers.
Internal Cache Storage: Moved update staging to internal app cache to bypass Android 11+ / HyperOS Scoped Storage file blocks.
Full FileProvider Permissions: Added missing XML roots and granted explicit read URI permissions to system package installers (MIUI, Samsung, Google).
Direct Browser Download Fallback: Added an instant 'Browser' download action directly inside the update alert dialog.
Auto-Install Trigger: Automatically launches the package installer prompt as soon as the APK download finishes.

changelog.title: Interactive Vinyl Turntable & Scratching
items: Scratch & Seek Vinyl Disc: Grab and spin the vinyl record in the player forward or backward to scrub through songs with real-time audio scrubbing physics.
Realistic Vinyl Scratch Sound: Synthesized needle-on-groove DJ scratch audio effect pitch-bent to your rotational drag velocity.
Animated Tonearm Stylus: Mechanical needle swings into the groove during playback and lifts away into resting stand on pause.
DJ Scratch Mode Easter Egg: Triple-tap the center vinyl label to trigger instant DJ Spinback mode!

changelog.title: Pure Size-Oriented Turntable Widget
items: Pure Turntable Platter: Clean circular vinyl deck with tonearm and ambient glow with no clutter, scaling responsively to any widget dimension.
Continuous Spin Tracking: Platter tracks live playback state directly from your home screen.

changelog.title: Library Playlist Reordering Fix
items: Silky Smooth Reordering: Swapped to 60fps in-memory list updates during drag so dragging never drops frames or gets canceled.
Atomic Drop Persistence: Preferences are saved once upon releasing the drag handle, eliminating DataStore write collisions.
